$source: docs/design/brand.md — the ev8.ge theme as read from the site on 13.09.2026, plus the few additions the operations UI needs. Values are never invented here; when the site changes, brand.md is updated from the source and this file follows it.
$howToRegenerate: node scripts/tokens.mjs   (--check compares instead of writing; CI runs the check)
$theme: One theme, light, by the owner's decision (14.09.2026, confirmed again 14.09.2026 evening). The dark mode of U13 is not built; if it ever comes back it is a second set of values in this file, not a second stylesheet.
$naming: A token name is camelCase here. The CSS custom property is its kebab-case form with a leading double dash: radiusCard -> --radius-card, textH1Phone -> --text-h1-phone. A digit belongs to the word it ends, so textH2 is --text-h2; where that rule gives the wrong name a token carries an explicit "css", as surface2 does. The TypeScript export keeps the camelCase name.

groups.name: text
groups.note: Named text styles. Fourteen of them, because the interface uses fourteen — the point is that they are named and counted, not that a component reaches for a size of its own. Each is a CSS `font` shorthand, so a rule says `font: var(--text-body)` and nothing else. The shorthand resets font-variant, so tabular figures are set by the .t-* class next to it, never by the token.
